dsh-api-gateway 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。为第三方客户端提供 REST + SSE 网关：API 密钥鉴权、token 流式回包、会话工作区分组，并可接管 GUI 会话继续对话。

posts.en:
dsh-api-gateway is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. REST + SSE gateway exposing running Harness sessions to third-party clients: API-key auth, token streaming, workspace grouping, and adopting GUI sessions to keep chatting.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-23a8224aca9637eaf59e.html
